title: World IT Show — Graphene Claims, Device Evidence, and Engineering Limits
research_question: Which claims in the Graphene Square company report remain defensible when ideal-material properties are separated from manufactured films, appliance performance, and safety?
scope: Retrospective audit of a 43-line company research report; no new physical experiment or verified student contribution.

related_projects.relation: Companion inquiry; cross-exhibition comparisons require separately verified sources.
